meta.name: benchling-integration
meta.description: Benchling Python SDK and REST API integration for registry entities, inventory, ELN entries, workflows, Benchling Apps, and Data Warehouse queries. Use when automating lab data with benchling-sdk or the v2 API.

copy.tagline: 自动化实验室数据管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Benchling平台上自动化处理实验数据与库存。
copy.tagline_en: Automate lab data management on Benchling
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate lab data and inventory operations on Benchling.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Python SDK 或 REST API 操作 Benchling 平台，包括管理 DNA/RNA/蛋白质等实体、库存、电子实验记录、工作流，以及查询数据仓库。
howto.when: 当你需要自动化处理 Benchling 上的实验数据，比如创建序列、转移样本、更新实验记录或触发工作流时，Claude 会调用此技能。

say.text: 帮我用 Benchling SDK 创建一个新的 DNA 序列。
say.note: Claude 会调用 SDK 创建 DNA 序列实体。

say.text: 把容器 cont_abc123 转移到 box_xyz789。
say.note: Claude 会执行容器转移操作。

say.text: 查询数据仓库中最近一周的样本数据。
say.note: Claude 会执行 SQL 查询并返回结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can interact with the Benchling platform via Python SDK or REST API, including managing registry entities (DNA, RNA, proteins), inventory, ELN entries, workflows, and querying the Data Warehouse.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to automate lab data tasks on Benchling, such as creating sequences, transferring samples, updating entries, or triggering workflows.

say_en.text: Create a new DNA sequence using the Benchling SDK.
say_en.note: Claude will call the SDK to create a DNA sequence entity.
Claude will perform the container transfer operation.

say_en.text: Query the Data Warehouse for sample data from the last week.
say_en.note: Claude will execute a SQL query and return results.
